mapper.select: SELECT pr.request_id AS requestId, pr.request_date AS requestDate, pr.due_date AS dueDate, i.name AS ingredientName, co.supplier_id AS supplierId, -- 공급업체 ID co.company_name AS companyName, -- 업체명 co.business_number AS businessNumber, co.representative_name AS representativeName, co.phone AS phone FROM purchase_requests pr LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON pr.ingredient_id = i.id LEFT JOIN suppliers co ON pr.supplier_id = co.supplier_id WHERE pr.request_id = #{requestId}
